 We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts. 
 Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us. 
 
 Taking ownership and driving impact  
 Being open to change and feedback 
 Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

 At Catawiki, our Platform Horizontal has evolved from solely managing the cloud into a broad function supporting Reliability, Developer Experience, Security, and Quality. We take a holistic approach to creating systems and tools that help developers deliver applications seamlessly and reliably without getting bogged down in infrastructure complexity. As a  Platform Engineer , you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. You’ll help shape and execute our long-term platform vision, empowering Catawiki teams to deliver value to customers with speed, reliability, and security.

 You’ll build and improve the platform capabilities that enable our engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate applications effectively at scale.

  Drive reliability and scalability  through applying practices for fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and scaling so applications run smoothly under changing conditions. 
  Improve platform operations  usage and enhance our observability stack to monitor platform health and resolve incidents proactively. 
  Collaborate and innovate  by partnering with product teams to understand their needs, build simple and impactful solutions, and champion cloud-native best practices across Catawiki.

 You measure what matters, introduce changes gradually, and treat failure as a normal part of learning. You use tooling and automation wherever possible to reduce toil, and enjoy sharing knowledge with others.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Backend Platform (USA Only, 100% Remote)
jobs.description:
About Us 
 Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so  Close  does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale. 
 We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales. 
 Our Stack 
 Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our  TaskTiger  scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented  public API  that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools.  
 We love open sourcing our code and ideas on  our GitHub  and on  The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like  SocketShark ,  TaskTiger ,  LimitLion  and  ciso8601 . 
 AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.  
 About the Role 
 Close runs on Python: Flask web apps, TaskTiger, billions of MongoDB documents, a public REST API that customers and external agents both build on. Four product teams ship features on top of that every week. Backend Platforms owns the foundation underneath it all. 
 As an Engineer on our Backend Platforms team, you’re building for other engineers. When a product team adds a new API endpoint, most of what they write isn't their feature — it's wiring: authentication, permissions, rate limiting, the shape the endpoint has to take so it looks like every other endpoint when you squint. Multiply that across telemetry, eventing, database migrations, authorization, and local development, and you get the problem this team exists to solve: make the paved road faster to walk than the trail. 
 The other half of the team's mandate is the AI development platform. We've built DevDawg, cloud-based development environments preconfigured for our entire application stack and our engineering practices, and Spice, our extension layer on top of a coding agent that runs internal review workflows and root cause analysis. Spice is hooked into GitHub and can already approve mergeable pull requests on its own for simple changes. This team is responsible for expanding what it can safely handle. 
 This is a new team. You would be one of the first hires, and you'd have unusual influence over what the team owns and how it operates. 
 One thing to know: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close — this team is where you'd start, but over time you'll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects. 
 This role is open at the Senior and Staff levels. You don't need to pick one when you apply: we'll calibrate together during the process. 

 You are 
 
 
  A seasoned Python engineer.  Python is our backbone and it matters in this role more than on other teams at Close. Architectural patterns don't port cleanly between languages, and you'll be setting the patterns. Go, Rust, or TypeScript alongside it is welcome. 
 
 
  Drawn to met

new_jobs.description:
Wir sind ein modernes IT-Dienstleistungsunternehmen und unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Betrieb sowie der Weiterentwicklung anspruchsvoller Infrastruktur- und Cloud-Umgebungen. Unser Fokus liegt auf nachhaltigen IT-Lösungen, Automatisierung, Security und Betriebskonzepten. 
 Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen Linux- und Netzwerk-Spezialisten, der sich für moderne Infrastruktur, Automatisierung und Security begeistert. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte, viel Eigenverantwortung und ein hoher Homeoffice-Anteil. 
 Aufgaben 
 
 Administration, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung von Linux-Servern mit Schwerpunkt Red Hat Enterprise Linux 
 Betreuung von Netzwerk- und Security-Infrastrukturen 
 Konfiguration und Betrieb von Firewalls, VPN- und Remote-Access-Lösungen 
 Verwaltung und Optimierung von Load-Balancern und Reverse-Proxys 
 Automatisierung von Betriebsprozessen mit Ansible und weiteren Werkzeugen 
 Betrieb von Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen 
 Analyse und Behebung komplexer Störungen in Kundenumgebungen 
 Unterstützung bei Architektur-, Migrations- und Modernisierungsprojekten 
 Dokumentation von Systemen und Prozessen 
 Gelegentliche Einsätze beim Kunden vor Ort oder im Rechenzentrum 
 
 Qualifikation 
 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von Linux-Systemen 
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Red Hat Enterprise Linux oder vergleichbaren Distributionen 
 Erfahrung mit Firewalls, Routing, Switching und Netzwerksicherheit 
 Gute Kenntnisse in Ansible und Infrastrukturautomatisierung 
 Erfahrung im Betrieb hochverfügbarer Umgebungen 
 Kenntnisse in HAProxy, Red Hat Satellite oder ähnlichen Technologien von Vorteil 
 Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, Container-Plattformen oder DevOps-Werkzeugen 
 Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise 
 Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
 Führerschein Klasse B 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Überwiegend Homeoffice 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten 
 Moderne Arbeitsausstattung 
 Spannende Kundenprojekte mit aktuellen Technologien 
 Umfangreiche Fortbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten 
 Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 
 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege 
 Kollegiales und technisch starkes Team 
 Langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Unternehmen 
 
 Du möchtest moderne Linux-, Netzwerk- und Security-Infrastrukturen aktiv mitgestalten und suchst eine Aufgabe mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
